Dropout is a regularization technique that randomly disables some activations during training; ordinary inference uses the trained network without that random disabling. Early stopping uses validation performance to decide when to end training, rather than selecting a stopping point using the held-out test results.

The tutor is therefore evaluated for factual correctness, support from the supplied documents, and appropriate handling of uncertainty. A failure to retrieve supporting evidence means that support was not found; it does not prove that the proposed claim is false.
